// This fixture is graph_like.go.txt's const block plus the two spec shapes
// PropertyTypes' doc comment names as the reason it refuses rather than
// drops: one that inherits its predecessor's value and one that is untyped.
//
// Both are usable everywhere a PropertyType is wanted — TypeAlias IS a
// PropertyType, and TypeUntyped converts to one implicitly — so dropping
// either would narrow the obligation a backend's table is held to without
// saying so, which is the harm the refusal exists to prevent.
package graph

// PropertyType is the type whose constants the walk collects.
type PropertyType string

const (
	TypeString PropertyType = "STRING"

	// TypeAlias inherits the spec above, so it carries neither a type nor a
	// value of its own and this walk sees no PropertyType on it — while the
	// compiler gives it type PropertyType and value "STRING".
	TypeAlias

	// TypeUntyped is an untyped string constant. Nothing marks it as a
	// PropertyType and it is assignable to one regardless.
	TypeUntyped = "UNTYPED"
)
